name: Option-O Lagom Mini (Obsidian burrs)
details: Compact single-dose electric grinder with 48 mm conical burrs; settings in dots from zero. These are the Obsidian burrs.

rangeInfo.note: Honest Coffee Guide's chart (community, not the manufacturer's): Turkish 6–31, espresso 26–53, moka pot 51–93, AeroPress 46–135, V60 57–99, filter coffee machine 43–127, French press 98–183, cold brew 114–198. Its V60 row is used for pour-over, “Filter Coffee Machine” for drip, French press for immersion.
rangeInfo.estimateNote: Estimated by extrapolating the cited ranges, not from the source: Rapid Brewer: from the middle of the AeroPress range to the middle of the pour-over range. Dial in from there.
